title: VSS view spec
description: Declarative description of a read-only VSS view. An agent emits this document; tools/vss-view/render_view.py turns it into a self-contained HTML file. The agent never writes markup.

subtitle.description: One line of context under the title.

slug.description: Filename stem for the rendered file and its snapshots.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; stamped by the renderer when omitted.

source_note.description: Footer note naming the deployment the data came from.

frozen.description: True in a saved snapshot: every source is treated as inline and no polling starts.

source.description: Where a block's rows come from. `inline` bakes them in at generation time (portable, static). `poll` re-fetches a VSS endpoint in the browser (live, only while the deployment is reachable).

raw.description: Optional full response object, for summary value_path lookups.

params.description: Query parameters; empty/null values are dropped.

items_path.description: Dot-path to the array inside the response. `incidents` for IncidentListResponse. Omit if the response is itself an array.

id_path.description: Dot-path to a stable per-item id; drives new-row detection.

empty_text.description: Shown when the source yields no rows. An empty result is a valid answer.

fields.description: Dot-path mapping from this block's logical fields onto the actual document shape. Incident documents are free-form nvschema, so paths are never assumed.

sensor_names.description: sensor_id (UUID) -> human name, reverse-resolved from VIOS by the agent. Ids with no entry render as the raw UUID.

value_path.description: Dot-path into the raw response, e.g. `total`.

count_of.description: Use the number of rows the source returned.
